description: Holds store user mapping records (defined in the EF Core model), linked to stores, users.
business_purpose: Used to track and report store user mapping records for the Factory & Inventory area.
record_granularity: One row represents one store user mapping.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the store user mapping.

columns.name: storeid
columns.description: Reference to the stores linked to this store user mapping.

columns.name: userId
columns.description: Reference to the users linked to this store user mapping.

relationships.description: Each store user mapping references one stores (store).
Each store user mapping references one users (user).

business_rules: Join to Stores, Users through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
